format_decision.compatibility_rule: C2D-v4 has not shipped. The v4-to-v5 correction before the first C2 release has no compatibility debt; the same change after a seal would require migration.
format_decision.depth_source: derived from the contiguous active source-kind-2 image records descending from slot 63; maximum four; no separately maintained depth field
format_decision.publication_rule: Transient bytes and all reverse edges are staged and validated first. The handle watermark is published last inside the existing non-GC-interruptible publication seam.
format_decision.removal_rule: The handle watermark is raised first, making removed handles unreachable, before the corresponding records and Attic bytes are wiped.
format_decision.restage_rule: Write inactive watermark 4096 before changing the generation. Old physical bytes may remain but no old transient handle is callable.

handle_domains.single_source_rule: The C2D header watermark is the only runtime transient-handle visibility state. Physical high-tail fronts and logical handles are arithmetic projections of it, not separately maintained counters.
handle_domains.collision_rule: persistent_entry_count + active_transient_entry_count <= 2048; equality is legal and the next record is rejected before journal or target mutation

hot_lookup_rule.input_boundary: Only BCODE_IDX values reach normalization, so the caller already proves 0..4095.
hot_lookup_rule.persistent: Reject index >= persistent_entry_count; physical ordinal equals logical index.
hot_lookup_rule.transient: Reject index < transient_handle_watermark; physical ordinal is index-2048.
hot_lookup_rule.shared_path: After normalization both domains use the existing c2_entry_records record/materialization path.
hot_lookup_rule.stage_boundary: Directory/image reverse edges, source kind, generation, interval ownership and record topology are validated before publish. The hot path must not duplicate immutable topology validation.
hot_lookup_rule.one_lookup_rule: No transient-tail locator, scan or second directory path may survive. There is one normalizer and one common entry-record path.

required_positive_cases: persistent handles preserve their current indices and physical ordinals
nested transient records allocate logical handles from 4095 downward and physical records from 2047 downward with constant translation
popping an inner record leaves outer handles valid
persistent publication below active transients does not alter transient handles
the exact persistent/transient meet is legal
publication makes a complete staged range visible only at the watermark write
required_negative_cases: a stale inner handle after normal pop is rejected
every transient handle after abort cleanup is rejected
every old transient handle after generation restage is rejected
a handle in the low/high hole is rejected
a malformed watermark below 2048 or above 4096 is rejected
a non-contiguous, overlapping or fifth transient image record is rejected before publication
one entry beyond the exact low/high meet is rejected before journal or target mutation
a transient handle presented before the publish-last watermark store is rejected
a removed handle is rejected after watermark raise even before record wipe

capacity_gate.baseline_lookup: Link-32 c2_entry_records calibrated against a target-shaped no-LTO object
capacity_gate.e000_policy: delta must be <= 0 bytes; the window remains closed to new tenants
capacity_gate.island_budget: normalizer plus the already projected 13-byte abort facade must fit the 109-byte Link-32 Island headroom

gc_measurement_requirement.next_hardware_presmoke: must report GC time/frames as a separate line; the 78 additional 32-byte reads may not be accepted by argument

fallback_order: If this contract/capacity probe is red, measure in-place reclaim of 126 bytes in the existing closure.
Only after both fail may an owner reopen the E000 closure with an explicitly lower floor; that is not reviewer-authorizable contingency use.
claim_limit: Contract, host state model and target-object capacity projection only. No product implementation, product link, hardware result, GC-latency acceptance or promotion is authorized.
